card: `npm run smoke` operator CLI: registry, list/status, safe parallel run, one summary
deviations_from_card: (1) Per critic: last-run record written to os.tmpdir()/mage-arena-smoke/last-run.json, not .smoke/ (no .gitignore edit). (2) package.json: only the `smoke` script appended at the end of scripts, under the lock, committed with cli.ts. (3) Case 3 'plan([w7-director],{allowPaid:true}) includes it': w7-director is also DOM-era dead (case 4), so with allowPaid it no longer throws and appears in plan.refused as retired rather than in steps; the allowPaid-includes path is proven on a synthetic live paid entry. Retired always wins, so even --allow-paid cannot start the dead paid suite. (4) Two commits (feat registry/plan/status + tests, then feat cli + package.json) instead of test-then-feat, so every commit is green. (5) --parallel batches by distinct registered --strictPort today (suites still hard-code ports) rather than waiting for Slot A's freePort.
notes: Unit tests only; no Playwright suite or preview server was run. Registry covers 27 entries (26 suite files matching *-browser/*-tour/*-performance/u6b-audio + u4-audit); retired: camp, parley, season, w7-scenes, w7-director (derived by deadLocators against packages/game/src; data-ready stays live via dataset.ready); paid: w7-director only. `npm run smoke -- run w7-director` exits 2 with the paid refusal; `run camp` skips with the [data-place] reason. Avoided Slot A's file names (preview/driver/checks/budgets). First gate run was red on sibling in-flight work (parley.test.ts, camp-subtitle.test.ts type errors); re-run after commits: gate exit 0, 798 vitest / 44 node.
